items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Sims Campbell and me used to go to school up there ... (something about my own band).

ctx.x: I mean to Missouri University, she had this little scholarship fund to send them to Illinois University. See what I mean? So Sims Campbell and me used to go to school up there ... (something about my own band). So Mrs. Malone -- I think she's a tremendous person -- she'd come up to Webster Groves and sit and talk to the kids, you know. Well, Sims I met around that time.
Yeah but what happened to this guy who picked you up?
